name: Unstable Handwraps

effects.name: Enhancement Bonus
effects.tooltip: +5 Enhancement Bonus : +5 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls .

effects.name: Anarchic Burst
effects.tooltip: Anarchic Burst : An anarchic weapon is chaotically aligned and infused with the power of chaos. It makes the weapon chaos-aligned and thus bypasses the corresponding damage reduction. It deals an extra 2 to 12 points of damage against all of lawful alignment and an extra 3 to 18 on a critical for weapons with a x2 critical multiplier, 4 to 24 for a x3 multiplier, and 5 to 30 for a x4 multiplier.

effects.name: Axiomatic Burst
effects.tooltip: Axiomatic Burst : An axiomatic weapon is lawfully aligned and infused with the power of law. It makes the weapon law-aligned and thus bypasses the corresponding damage reduction. It deals an extra 2 to 12 points of damage against all of chaotic alignment and an extra 3 to 18 on a critical for weapons with a x2 critical multiplier, 4 to 24 for a x3 multiplier, and 5 to 30 for a x4 multiplier.

effects.name: Lawful Outsider Bane
effects.tooltip: Lawful Outsider Bane : A bane weapon excels at attacking one type or subtype of creature. Against Lawful Outsiders, this weapon's effective enhancement bonus is +2 better than its normal enhancement bonus. It deals an extra 2 to 12 points of damage against the foe.

effects.name: Chaotic Outsider Bane
effects.tooltip: Chaotic Outsider Bane : A bane weapon excels at attacking one type or subtype of creature. Against Chaotic Outsiders, this weapon's effective enhancement bonus is +2 better than its normal enhancement bonus. It deals an extra 2 to 12 points of damage against the foe.

effects.name: Mind Turbulence
effects.tooltip: Mind Turbulence : This item fills your mind with chaos, disrupting your thoughts and causing a -10 Concentration penalty.

flavor_text: Once brimming with only the power of lawfulness, these handwraps have become slowly twisted by Xoriat. Yet they have not yet shed their original nature, leaving them in a state of confusing double-alignment that has a disorienting affect on the wearer's mind.
tips: You can remove the Mind Turbulence penalty with a Sustaining Symbiont .
